_comment: GIST-960 (1M, 960d L2). High-dim SPANN: head_ratio=0.30 (vs 0.25 for 96-128d) because in high dim head quality dominates recall. posting_page_limit=20 (vs 16) since at 960d each vector occupies ~3.8 KB — a 16-page (64 KB) posting only holds ~17 vectors. internal_result_num=128 / max_check=16384 widen search candidates. num_threads/io_threads=32 caps build wall-clock.
